_comment: Ground-truth must-find checklist. Each entry matches a finding when ALL of its `match` substrings appear (case-insensitive) across the finding's title+description+source. `required:true` entries HARD-FAIL the harness if unmatched (no false negatives); `required:false` are informational (printed found/not-found) — used where the deterministic tool output is real but less guaranteed, so version drift doesn't break the gate. Calibrated conservatively because the harness must be reliable on first run; tighten (flip false→true) once a live run confirms a finding is consistently produced.

minimums._comment: Coarse 'it actually found things' floor. from_dast_required is FALSE for now: the deterministic engine's DAST scanners run but their output isn't extracted (Tier 1.1 backlog) — the harness reports it as a loud warning rather than failing the gate, since this is the secondary/continuous engine, not the LLM-orchestrated product. Flip to true once DAST extraction is fixed.

unauth.note: Juice Shop ships without a proper CSP / security headers — reliably surfaced by header/CORS checks.
Tech/version fingerprint of the Juice Shop app.
SQL/NoSQL injection — deterministic injection coverage is partial, so informational.

authed.note: Authorization/IDOR finding — proves the authed AUTHZ tests produced a result. Informational until a live run confirms the exact title.

sast.note: NodeGoat is deliberately vulnerable (injection, weak crypto, etc.) — a SAST scanner MUST produce at least one finding against it.
Hardcoded secret / vulnerable dependency in NodeGoat.
